gloss: to go too far; to be excessive; to overdo it

definitions.gloss: to go too far; to be excessive; to overdo it
definitions.explanation: Something exceeds an acceptable or reasonable limit. Used to criticize behavior, actions, or situations that have gone beyond what is appropriate.

examples.japanese: いたずらも{度|ど}が{過|す}ぎる。
examples.english: The pranks have gone too far.

examples.japanese: {冗談|じょうだん}も{度|ど}が{過|す}ぎると、{人|ひと}を{傷|きず}つけることがある。
examples.english: When jokes go too far, they can hurt people.

examples.japanese: {心配|しんぱい}するのはわかるけど、{度|ど}が{過|す}ぎると{子供|こども}の{自立|じりつ}を{妨|さまた}げることになる。
examples.english: I understand being worried, but when it goes too far, it can hinder a child's independence.

notes:
Combines {度|ど} (degree, extent) with {過|す}ぎる (to exceed). Expresses the idea that something has crossed the line of what is acceptable. Almost always used in a critical or cautionary tone.

USAGE:
Typically follows a noun with the particle も: {冗談|じょうだん}も{度|ど}が{過|す}ぎる (even jokes can go too far). The も adds the nuance of "even X has limits." Can also be used as a modifier: {度|ど}が{過|す}ぎた{行為|こうい} (an act that went too far).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {冗談|じょうだん}も{度|ど}が{過|す}ぎる — jokes have gone too far
- いたずらも{度|ど}が{過|す}ぎる — pranks have gone too far
- {心配|しんぱい}も{度|ど}が{過|す}ぎる — worrying has gone too far
- {度|ど}が{過|す}ぎた{行為|こうい} — an excessive act

SIMILAR WORDS:
- やり{過|す}ぎる — to overdo it; more casual, broader application
- {行|い}き{過|す}ぎる — to go too far; similar meaning, often used for actions or policies
- {過度|かど}な — excessive; formal adjective form
